mapper.update: UPDATE intent_fewshot_sample SET query_text = #{queryText}, intent_code = #{intentCode}, example_json = #{exampleJson}, dimension = #{dimension}, embedding = #{embedding}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, query_text, intent_code, example_json, dimension, embedding, status, create_time, update_time FROM intent_fewshot_sample WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, query_text, intent_code, example_json, dimension, embedding, status, create_time, update_time FROM intent_fewshot_sample WHERE intent_code = #{intentCode} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, query_text, intent_code, example_json, dimension, embedding, status, create_time, update_time FROM intent_fewshot_sample WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
